Biography
Malaqi was born on August 6, 2006 in  Roanoke, Virginia
Career
mctheking is an independent musical artist and producer who emerged in the mid-2020s. They are primarily known for their high-energy, digital-first sound that blends elements of dance-pop, hip-hop, and electronic music. The artist gained significant online attention following the release of the single "LALALA" in late 2025. The origins of mctheking are rooted in the "internet-era" music scene, where they began distributing tracks through global streaming services. Unlike traditional artists who sign with major labels early on, mctheking built an initial audience through viral potential and algorithmic playlists.
"LALALA" (2025)
Released in August 2025, "LALALA" serves as the artist's breakout single.
Production: The track features a signature melodic hook ("la la la") set against modern production styles like slap house and future bass.
Distribution: The song was featured on major platforms including iHeartRadio, Apple Music, and Spotify.
Reception: It has been described as a "vibe-focused" anthem, often compared to the upbeat, viral energy of artists like Y2K or producers in the electronic dance music (EDM) space.
